compile_rules.interpretation: The pilot is an elementary move with elementary numeric sending and numeric-edited receiving items.
compile_rules.applicability: elementary items only; MOVE CORRESPONDING and group moves excluded

compile_rules.interpretation: MOVE converts the internal numeric representation and applies editing required by the receiving item.
compile_rules.applicability: COMP-5 numeric sender to DISPLAY numeric-edited receiver

compile_rules.interpretation: Numeric and numeric-edited moves align on the decimal point and zero-fill where editing does not replace zeros.
A signed receiver receives the sender sign with the conversion required by its representation.
compile_rules.applicability: signed COMP-5 sender and floating-minus edited receiver

compile_rules.interpretation: The numeric-edited receiver is formatted according to its PICTURE string.
A numeric integer sender is valid for a numeric-edited receiving item.

all: editing causes replacement of leading zeros
compile_rules.interpretation: Numeric-edited receivers align on the decimal point and may replace leading zeros as directed by editing.

all: number of character positions in the sending item
one character position for the floating insertion symbol
compile_rules.interpretation: A floating-insertion receiver needs all sending numeric positions plus one insertion position to avoid truncation; PIC ----9 has four numeric positions and one floating-sign position, so moving 99999 truncates the high-order digit and produces space followed by 9999.
compile_rules.applicability: integer sender to PIC ----9 floating-minus numeric-edited receiver
